g.text: Within-cohort training across four external ECG cohorts
Equal cohort averages • 95% paired seed-mean intervals, five seeds • Not cross-cohort encoder transfer
CLOCS-style reuses the SimCLR fallback in three cohorts; diagnostic improvements are not universal.
